title: rhinanthus alectorolophus subsp. buccalis

This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being studied, but it is believed to contain a variety of compounds including iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
